title: Update on Digital Cooperation between Singapore and Indonesia through Nongsa Digital Park and its Outlook
what_it_is: Update on Digital Cooperation between Singapore and Indonesia through Nongsa Digital Park and its Outlook

sections.label: Nongsa Digital Park tech talent
sections.summary: About 1,000 tech talents in Nongsa Digital Park serve some 250 Singapore-based companies, and data centre players announced investments there.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Around 1,000 tech talents in 	Nongsa Digital Park are currently servicing some 250 Singapore-based companies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Singapore-based data centre players, such as Princeton Digital Group, GDS Holdings and Gaw Capital, have also announced data centre investments in 	Nongsa Digital Park to serve Southeast Asia.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: These projects support Singapore and Indonesia’s digital economies and create jobs for both countries.

sections.label: Nongsa as digital bridge
sections.summary: Nongsa Digital Park is described as Singapore's digital bridge to Indonesia's digital economy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: If I could elaborate and share a bit of context, Nongsa Digital Park is Singapore's digital bridge to Indonesia's digital economy.

sections.label: Park serves Singapore companies
sections.summary: It now serves about 250 Singapore-based companies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Despite that, it now serves about 250 Singapore-based companies.

sections.label: Nongsa Digital Town progress
sections.summary: Nongsa Digital Town is under construction and will house 8,000 more tech talents, with The Hive phase completing next year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: He asked in the second supplementary question about the progress.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: It has been two years, it is undergoing construction and when completed, the Nongsa Digital Town will house an additional 8,000 tech talents that will continue to serve Singapore-based companies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The initial phase of the development – there is one interesting development called The Hive, and it will be completed in the second half of next year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: When completed, it will comprise a mixed development of food and beverage (F&B) outlets, co-working spaces and also community spaces.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, I want to use this platform to assure Mr Saktiandi Supaat that MTI and our economic agencies will certainly work closely with our Indonesian counterparts and industry stakeholders to continue to expand partnership between Singapore-based companies and the BBK region.
